title: track_changed
description: Sent by the plugin as soon as the room names a track other than the one it was on, whoever changed it. A change a set_track or next_track asked for (commanded) had its race_reset when the command arrived. Any other change, such as a track the host picked in game, is followed straight away by a race_reset with reason room_track_change. Carries the race_id of the race running when the room changed.

workshop_id.description: Steam Workshop ID of the race being flown, else of its track, read off the room's content (ManagedID); room property W as a last resort. Only when there is one: Liftoff's own tracks have none

commanded.description: True when this is the change a set_track or next_track asked for
